blocks.goal: Extract the instance-based random generation responsibility into a new class RandomGenerator to reduce the number of public instance methods and overall method count in RandomUtils. Move the instance methods that implement random value generation and their supporting state (the Supplier<Random>) into the extracted class. Update RandomUtils to hold a private RandomGenerator field and delegate static deprecated methods to that field so external behavior is preserved.

expected_impact.rationale: The instance-level random generation methods (randomBoolean, randomBytes, randomDouble(), randomDouble(range), randomFloat(), randomFloat(range), randomInt(), randomInt(range), randomLong(), randomLong(range)) are cohesive and will be moved into RandomGenerator along with the Supplier<Random> field and private helper randomLong(long). This removes 10 public instance methods and two helper methods from RandomUtils, noticeably reducing public method count, total method count, and LOC in RandomUtils. RandomUtils will keep static factory methods and single private RandomGenerator field; deprecated static convenience methods are updated to delegate to that field, preserving behavior.

ops.details: Create new class org.apache.commons.lang3.RandomGenerator that encapsulates the instance-level random generation behavior. The new class will have a private final Supplier<Random> supplier and provide methods: boolean randomBoolean(); byte[] randomBytes(int); double randomDouble(); double randomDouble(double, double); float randomFloat(); float randomFloat(float, float); int randomInt(); int randomInt(int, int); long randomLong(); long randomLong(long, long); package-private Random random(); and a private long randomLong(long n) helper. The logic of these methods is moved verbatim from RandomUtils, preserving behavior. The class is placed in the same package (org.apache.commons.lang3).

Move the instance field 'private final Supplier<Random> random' out of RandomUtils into RandomGenerator as a private final Supplier<Random> supplier. Update constructors in RandomUtils to instantiate RandomGenerator with the existing supplier argument instead of storing it directly.

Move the following instance methods from RandomUtils into RandomGenerator, preserving their implementations: randomBoolean(), randomBytes(int), randomDouble(), randomDouble(double,double), randomFloat(), randomFloat(float,float), randomInt(), randomInt(int,int), randomLong(), randomLong(long,long). Also move the package-private method Random random() and the private helper long randomLong(long n). Remove these methods from RandomUtils. RandomGenerator will expose the moved methods with the same signatures (except accessibility where necessary).

Update all call sites inside RandomUtils that previously invoked the moved instance methods (for example, secure().randomBoolean(), secure().randomBytes(...), etc.) to delegate to the new RandomGenerator instance stored as a private field in RandomUtils. For example, replace secure().randomBoolean() with secure().generator.randomBoolean() where 'generator' is a new private final RandomGenerator field initialized by the RandomUtils constructors. Also update RandomUtils.toString() to use the generator's random() or generator.toString() as appropriate.

Ensure both sources have the necessary imports (java.util.Random, java.util.function.Supplier and any existing imports already present). Place RandomGenerator in the same package so no package change is necessary.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
